$comment: The venue service's regulatory content, from the reference prototype. The classification derives from the same NEHRAT engine as events, over one routine operating session; it stands twelve months (levels.json), sets a FLOOR for organizers using the venue and does not certify their events.

applicabilityIntro.$comment: The reference intro reads 'completes the the risk assessment assessment' -- a doubling left by substituting the instrument's name out of the copy. Rendered once here; the 1,000 figure is the recurring-venue condition's own threshold (minimum-conditions.json), quoted as regulatory copy.
applicabilityIntro.en: A venue that regularly hosts organized events and has an approved or licensed capacity of 1,000 persons or more completes the risk assessment once each year for its routine operations.
applicabilityIntro.ar: الموقع الذي يستضيف بانتظام فعاليات منظمة وسعته المعتمدة أو المرخّصة 1,000 شخص أو أكثر يستكمل تقييم المخاطر مرة كل سنة لتشغيله الاعتيادي.

registrationFields.en: Responsible contact for health and medical preparedness
registrationFields.ar: جهة الاتصال المسؤولة عن التأهب الصحي والطبي

eligibilityQuestions.$comment: The two yes/no facts the minimum conditions need from a venue. The regularly-hosts question serves the recurring-venue row (both issues; the Level 2 floor is the Arabic issue's). The nightclub question exists ONLY because of the English issue's nightclub/dance-venue condition -- the prototype lacks it; tagged en-only so it reads as issue-specific, not a design choice (reviewer instruction, Slice 3 approval).

regularlyHosts.en: Does the venue regularly host organized events?
regularlyHosts.ar: هل يستضيف الموقع بانتظام فعاليات منظمة؟

nightclub.en: Is the venue a nightclub or dance venue?
nightclub.ar: هل الموقع ملهى ليلي أو مكان للرقص؟

changeAspects.consequenceEn: Can cross the 10,000 and 20,000 minimum-level thresholds
changeAspects.consequenceAr: قد يتجاوز عتبتَي 10,000 و20,000 للحد الأدنى للمستوى

changeAspects.consequenceEn: Can trigger a minimum event level
changeAspects.consequenceAr: قد يستدعي حداً أدنى لمستوى الفعالية

floorNote.$comment: Added at reviewer instruction (handoff 5 approval): said wherever an organizer could mistake the classification for an event certification.
floorNote.en: This classification sets a floor for events held at the venue: no event here can be classified below it. It does not certify any event — each event completes its own assessment and its own submission.
floorNote.ar: يحدد هذا التصنيف حداً أدنى للفعاليات المقامة في الموقع: لا يمكن تصنيف أي فعالية هنا دونه. وهو لا يعتمد أي فعالية — فكل فعالية تستكمل تقييمها الخاص وتقديمها الخاص.

registrationCriterion.$comment: Protocol 3.1, English issue: a recurring event venue that regularly hosts organized events AND has an approved or licensed capacity of this many persons or more is classified annually. This threshold used to be read from the recur minimum condition; the partner ruling (English governs) removed that condition, and the venue instrument keeps the criterion, so the number lives here now.
